reason: An MCP vision service that gives text-based LLMs image understanding through OCR, inspection, annotation, layout analysis, screenshot reconstruction, and image comparison using configurable vision backends.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 将本地或远程图像接入视觉模型，为文本模型提供 OCR、图像分析、界面检查、布局解析、截图重建和图像比较能力。
summaries.en: An MCP vision service that connects images to configurable vision models for OCR, visual analysis, UI inspection, layout parsing, screenshot reconstruction, and image comparison.

capabilities: Accepts base64-encoded images and remote HTTP(S) image URLs
Sends image content to configured local or external vision backends
Performs OCR, image inspection, annotation, layout analysis, reconstruction, and comparison
Generates HTML, React, or SVG code from screenshots
